title: Create Binary Tree From Descriptions
summary: Given a 2D integer array describing parent-child relationships in a binary tree, construct the tree and return its root.
statement: Given a 2D integer array describing parent-child relationships in a binary tree, construct the tree and return its root. Each relationship specifies a parent, a child, and the child's position (left or right). The array ensures a valid binary tree structure.
constraints: Each description is [parent,child,is_left], where one means left and zero means right.
All values are unique and the descriptions form exactly one valid binary tree.
Return the root node; child positions and sparse shape must be preserved.

reference_solution:
def create_tree_from_descriptions(descriptions):
    nodes={};children=set()
    for parent,child,is_left in descriptions:
        nodes.setdefault(parent,TreeNode(parent));nodes.setdefault(child,TreeNode(child))
        if is_left:nodes[parent].left=nodes[child]
        else:nodes[parent].right=nodes[child]
        children.add(child)
    root=next(value for value in nodes if value not in children)
    return nodes[root]
